name: qregime
summary: Open-source tool that decides whether a circuit should run with error mitigation, partial QEC, or full fault tolerance.
details: Rotated surface-code memory experiments with Stim and PyMatching, with a threshold consistent with the published ~1%.
FTQC resource estimation in physical qubits and runtime, cross-checked against Azure Quantum Resource Estimator and CUDA-Q.
10,000+ lines of Python with CI tests. Apache 2.0.

name: Quantum Circuit Playground
summary: Interactive statevector simulator in React: build circuits on up to four qubits, read Pauli expectation values, export OpenQASM 2.0 for qregime, and see a qregime-style noise estimate across hardware profiles.

name: Qaly the Quantum Cat
summary: Open-source educational series of 60-second animated explainers on quantum computing, hardware, and gates, built with Python, Manim, and Kokoro TTS.

name: Differentiable Quantum Circuits tutorial
summary: Trains a parameterized circuit to solve the ODE y'' + w²y = 0 with parameter-shift derivatives and no training data, then examines hardware noise with a Steane [[7,1,3]] error-correction module, an IBM calibration-based noise model, and error mitigation.

name: Qiskit Global Summer School 2026 — Noise Lab
summary: Co-created and taught the Noise Lab for ~12,000 registrants: 155 GitHub stars, 88 forks, translated into Japanese.

name: Qiskit Global Summer School 2025 — Noise Lab
summary: Co-created and taught the Noise Lab for 8,000+ registrants from 115 countries, translated into Japanese and Korean.

name: Quantum Counselor for Portfolio Investment
summary: Co-developed. 1st place, QHack 2022 Financial challenge. Hybrid LSTM and quantum neural network forecasting feeding a multi-period portfolio optimization formulated as a QUBO, solved with QAOA and VQE and benchmarked against CPLEX.

name: Quantum Supply Chain Manager
summary: Co-developed at Creative Destruction Lab 2022. Backorder prediction on 1.69M products with a quantum neural network, plus vehicle routing with QAOA and VQE benchmarked against Docplex.

name: Quantum K-NN
summary: Quantum k-nearest-neighbors implementation with Qiskit and GPU.
